title: World, Scene, Combat, Exploration & Creator Integration
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main b166659b44ffa0799415bd391a30442a9f08ea72 and application main 7d073bd3c9487d665751c76d2b5a69d3991ab305, re-reading MAI-08 and current MIB-11/D18, A5 Scene, visibility-projection and D29 authoring-provenance owner seams, then resolving a fail-closed proposal/command handoff that preserves all owner authority.
objective: Implement a deterministic integration handoff from validated MAI-08 presentation-authoring draft snapshots into explicit World, Scene, Visibility, Combat/Exploration and Creator/D29 owner requests and acknowledgements. MAI-09 may coordinate and reconcile owner operations but may not infer, replace or independently mutate owner truth.

input_boundary.input: MAI-08 deterministic draft snapshot plus draft receipt and preserved MAI-01..08 evidence references.
input_boundary.validation: Recompute/validate draft shape and receipt, require no blocking evidence, reject unresolved assignment activation, and revalidate permission/provenance before any owner request is produced.
input_boundary.rule: A draft is intent/evidence only; no owner mutation follows from draft existence, save or export.

world.handoff: Carry explicit stable World/location/taxonomy references only. Presentation layers, coordinates, visual connectivity and geometry may not create World hierarchy, topology, route, chronology, compatibility or navigation assertions.
world.acknowledgement: World references are accepted only when the owner reauthorizes current references/evidence; unknown or stale references remain rejected/unresolved.

scene.handoff: Translate explicitly mapped draft placeables/layers into Scene placement/map-version proposals carrying semantic location, source-definition references, visibility-policy references, expected owner versions and operation IDs. Draft coordinates alone are insufficient semantic location.
scene.acknowledgement: Only A5 owner results create or update runtime Scene state; rejected/stale/invalid proposals leave the MAI draft and owner state unchanged.

visibility.handoff: Carry visibility-policy references and presentation occlusion hints as non-authoritative evidence. Audience visibility, hidden state, reveal state, occlusion authorization and line-of-sight must be resolved by the owning authorization/projection systems before projection or activation.
visibility.rule: MAI never converts a visual occlusion hint into permission or hidden-state truth.

gameplay.handoff: Carry explicit owner object/action/interaction references only. MAI-04 visual connectivity and MAI-05 collision/cover/movement/interaction/portal hints remain descriptive until the owning gameplay domain accepts an explicit binding.
gameplay.rule: No visual wall, doorway, terrain, portal or interactable automatically blocks movement, grants cover, triggers an Action or causes a consequence.

creator.handoff: Creator integration may create/submit a proposal reference and carry the MAI draft receipt/provenance references. Review, approval, publication and canonical promotion remain separate owner gates.
creator.rule: Publication requires current proposal version, explicit publisher authority and a D29 PublicationReceipt; MAI integration receipt is never publication evidence.

reconciliation.atomicity: MAI-09 does not claim an owner integration accepted until every requested owner binding has a recorded owner acknowledgement. Partial owner acceptance is reported explicitly and remains reconcilable; no compensating deletion or hidden rollback is invented.
reconciliation.retry: Ambiguous owner outcomes require owner operation-status lookup with the original operation/idempotency identity before retry.
reconciliation.revocation: Permission/provenance revocation before owner commit fails closed; later revocation is handled by the owning domain and surfaced as reconciliation-required rather than silently reauthorizing.

receipt.determinism: Canonical ordering of draft receipt, owner requests, owner references, expected versions, decisions and diagnostics yields a platform-neutral MAI-09 integration-plan receipt.
receipt.meaning: Receipt proves deterministic orchestration evidence only; it is not World, Scene, visibility, gameplay or publication truth.

persistence.result: No new MAI-owned durable owner-state or integration ledger is required by the resolved contract. Existing owner operation/version/provenance records remain authoritative.
persistence.rule: Implementation remains contract/client-local/test-fixture plus existing owner-port boundaries; migration 0022 requires a separately demonstrated durable delta.

validation_contract.focused: Add MAI-09 deterministic integration preflight/plan/reconciliation verifier and client integration regression covering valid handoff, unresolved/permission/stale failures, owner-neutral request generation, partial acknowledgement, D29 publication separation and receipt order independence.
validation_contract.predecessors: Preserve MAI-08..01 plus MIB-11/D18, A5 Scene, visibility/projection and D29 owner-boundary regressions.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and applicable focused/predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..08 completed evidence remains binding and cannot be silently discarded
MAI-08 presentation-authoring drafts remain intent/evidence until explicit owner acceptance
no vendor/editor/provider becomes canonical Multiversal truth and no pack is assumed complete
permission and semantic compatibility are not inferred
manual assignment and approved-placeholder remain explicit; visibly-unresolved assignments cannot be activated
A5 Scene/Tabletop owns runtime Scene/map-version/placement state
Combat/Exploration and Action owners own collision/cover/movement/interaction/trigger/portal/consequence truth
D29 owns proposal review/publication/provenance and canonical promotion remains separate
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
nonauthorization: deriving World truth from artwork or MAI geometry
direct MAI mutation of Scene/Visibility/Combat/Exploration/D29 owner state
automatic activation of unresolved, denied, unknown or revoked assets
canonical promotion or publication without D29 owner receipt
migration 0022 without separately demonstrated and governed persistence delta
next_action: Implement the bounded MAI-09 candidate on integration/mai-09-world-scene-combat-exploration-creator-integration from application baseline 7d073bd3c9487d665751c76d2b5a69d3991ab305, beginning with deterministic preflight/integration-plan/reconciliation contracts and focused owner-boundary regression evidence.
